theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [Bialgebra k H] (D : Subalgebra k H) (hΔ : ∀ x ∈ D, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ D, ∃ b ∈ D, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}), ∃ bD : Bialgebra k D, bD.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra k D) ∧ (letI : Algebra k D := bD.toAlgebra; letI : Module k D := Algebra.toModule; letI : Bialgebra k D := bD; ∃ ι : BialgHom k D H, ∀ d : D, ι d = (d : H))
theorems.natural_summary: Packages the accepted coproduct lift and coalgebra-law descent into a bialgebra preserving the existing algebra structure, with the inclusion as a bialgebra homomorphism.
